expectation: Membrane rings on helper T cells (bright) and dimmer rings on monocytes and macrophages. Expect it to be common in stroma and lymphoid aggregates, scattered or clustered between tumour nests, and largely absent from the tumour epithelium.
observed: A: yellow stroma and dense immune-rich areas in several ROIs, with dark tumour nests. B/C: sparse, as expected for epithelial fields. D: clear membrane rings around nuclei. E: CD4 sits largely on CD3+ cells (white), with some CD3-only cells and a few green CD4-only (myeloid) cells.
why: CD4 shows membrane rings in stromal and lymphoid aggregates that leave out the tumour nests, and it overlaps a subset of CD3+ cells as expected.
notes: CD4 stains membrane rings in immune-rich stroma and aggregates, mostly on CD3+ T cells, with a few CD3-negative (likely myeloid) cells. The tumour nests are dark, so this is not haze that follows cell density.
